english.title: Fail to surrender a firearm on revocation of certificate
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a firearms certificate which had been revoked by the chief officer of police, in respect of **(..SPECIFY FIREARM OR FIREARMS..), failed to comply with a notice under section 12(1) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988 issued on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ISSUE..), requiring you to surrender forthwith the

(A)_[firearm]_
(B)_[firearms]_

which

(C)_[was]_
(D)_[were]_

in your possession by virtue of the certificate
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) and (2) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
